summary: s.demir@aegean.edu shows anomalous access. F1 confirms eight suspicious sign-ins from Cloudvault VPS (DE) outside the account baseline, consistent with valid account use. F3 confirms VPN appliance vpn-edge-01 runs CISA KEV-listed firmware with exploitable CVEs, exposing external access. F2 indicates most sign-ins originate from DE across eight events. Verdict: escalate per Risk Gate confidence 0.51.

contrastive.explanation: Rejecting F1, F3 would leave no surviving signal and the policy would land on benign — the opposite of the human-review path we chose.

risk.rationale: Not benign: no rejected claims explain away the DE/Cloudvault sign-ins, and F2 is only LIKELY with no technique. Not monitor: F1 and F3 are CONFIRMED, not weak. Not contain: F1 confirms non-baseline cloud-account sign-ins and F3 confirms a CISA KEV-exposed VPN appliance, but the takeover chain is not confirmed because vpn_session_order DQ fails for vpn-edge-01 and there is no confirmed exploit/session linkage to the cloud sign-ins. This is exposure plus conflicting/insufficient evidence needing human review. Confirmed findings F1 and F3 support escalating rather than contain.
